CustomField.label: Resume Link Base URL
CustomField.description: Base URL of the page a resume link points at, e.g. https://<site-domain>/gtmaccelerator/s/configurator. Server-side only, and deliberately NOT taken from the browser: an emailed link whose host came from the caller is an open redirect with our name on the envelope. Left blank here and set per org (see docs/runbooks/questionnaire-resume.md); when blank, GtmAssessmentDraftController falls back to Site.getBaseSecureUrl() and refuses to send at all if that is also blank.
